_doc: Known-item ranking baseline for the committed demo/ vault (#197). Measured with llmwiki.search over wiki pages only (title queries). mrr_* is mean reciprocal rank rounded to 6 decimal places; rank1_* is the share of titled pages ranked first for their own title. Update deliberately when demo content changes — exact comparison, no tolerance. Regenerated by measuring demo/ after scripts/generate_demo_sessions.py (sessions) and any wiki edits; see tests/test_197_acceptance.py.
